response.overview: In just a few years, Geoguessr and its small community have grown tremendously. What used to only be a fun geography game has evolved into a competitive esport with incredibly skilled players. One year ago, Lennli took a big step and decided to make Geoguessr and content creation his job in order to fully commit to training and being a pro player. In this 90-minute documentary we accompany him on this journey and learn about everything that is required to be able to compete on the highest level. What drives players? What challenges do they face? And how do they see the future of the esport?
